create_descriptor_from_proto: create a protobuf Descriptor from a DescriptorProto message using MakeDescriptor with package and syntax
inspect_message_fields: inspect all fields of a protobuf message descriptor using fields_by_name and fields_by_number dictionaries
get_field_type_info: get the proto type and C++ type of a field using FieldDescriptor type constants and ProtoTypeToCppProtoType
resolve_enum_values: resolve enum value names from numbers using EnumDescriptor values_by_number and EnumValueName helper method
copy_descriptor_to_proto: copy a FileDescriptor or Descriptor to its corresponding descriptor_pb2 proto using CopyToProto method
